description:
Draft, revise, and organize the scripts you read on camera, without leaving the conversation. Connect your Teleprompter.com account and ChatGPT can write a script with you, then save it straight to your workspace, filed in the right folder and ready for your next take.

What ChatGPT can do:

- Create scripts with playback settings applied as they're written: font size, scroll speed, timed-speed mode, text alignment, and estimated duration
- Revise existing scripts in place. Updates touch only the fields you ask for, so the rest of your setup stays as you left it
- Read your library: list scripts newest first, pull the full text of any script, and see what's inside each folder
- Organize: create folders, rename them, and move scripts between folders or back to the root

Because ChatGPT can read what you've already written, you can work from your own back catalogue: ask for a tighter cut of last month's intro, a 30-second version of a product explainer, or a consistent sign-off across everything in one folder.

You'll need a Teleprompter.com account; the integration is available on every account tier. Connecting uses OAuth, so there are no keys to copy or store, and you choose which permissions to grant: reading and writing scripts and folders are separate approvals, so read-only access is a valid choice. ChatGPT only ever sees your own personal workspace.

Scripts saved here are the same scripts your Teleprompter apps read, so anything drafted in a conversation is waiting for you the next time you open one up.

Differences from the Claude description, both deliberate:

defaultPrompt: Write a 60-second script for my product launch and save it
Shorten my newest script to 30 seconds
Show me my scripts and how they're organized
